title: Scientific Data Skills: Enabling Agent-Ready Scientific Data Services at Scale
abstract: arXiv:2608.19625v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific data are increasingly used by AI agents, yet existing dataset representations provide limited support for autonomous discovery, interpretation, and invocation. This limitation stems from the fragmentation of scientific data across heterogeneous repositories and from dataset representations designed primarily for human use. To address this limitation, we introduce the Scientific Data Skill (SciDSK), an agent-ready representation that packages dataset-specific knowledge and operational guidance as a reusable agent skill. A SciDSK integrates dataset descriptions, scientific context, file organization, usage procedures, quality checks, and provenance information while retaining the underlying data in its original repository. We define a structured SciDSK specification and develop a systematic construction pipeline that grounds each SciDSK in authoritative dataset records and associated supporting materials. translated_title: 科学数据技能：实现规模化智能体就绪的科学数据服务
translated_abstract: 科学数据正越来越多地被AI智能体使用，然而现有的数据集表示方式在自主发现、解释和调用方面支持有限。这一局限性源于科学数据在异构存储库中的碎片化，以及主要为人类使用而设计的数据集表示方式。为解决这一问题，我们引入了科学数据技能（SciDSK），一种智能体就绪的表示方式，将数据集特定知识和操作指南打包为可复用的智能体技能。SciDSK整合了数据集描述、科学背景、文件组织、使用流程、质量检查和溯源信息，同时将底层数据保留在原始存储库中。我们定义了一个结构化的SciDSK规范，并开发了一个系统化的构建流程，将每个SciDSK基于权威数据集记录和相关支持材料进行落地。我们进一步建立了该领域的基准评估体系。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SciDSK的智能体就绪数据集表示方法，通过整合数据知识、操作指南和溯源信息，解决了科学数据在AI智能体应用中的碎片化和人本设计局限，实现了规模化可复用的科学数据服务。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SciDSK, an agent-ready dataset representation that packages dataset-specific knowledge and operational guidance into reusable skills, addressing fragmentation and human-centric design limitations to enable scalable scientific data services for AI agents.
